authority: Owner-directed continuation with reasonable history/online-based assumptions; assistant adopts the values below for conditional numerical evaluation.

assumptions.plywood: Two nominal19.05mm generic-birch leaves; existing conditional APA24oc PS1Group1 five-ply response/strength proxy;36.5mm credited wall.
assumptions.adhesive: Retained structural-cleat T88 exception; full-face well-made wood-limited bond on clean unfinished faces, correct mix and full cure.
assumptions.normal_basis: Project assumption for the weakest panel/internal/new face-bond normal path: round down the previously sourced weaker278psi panel sample divided by5. Not a Paged minimum or a measured T88 normal adhesion value.
assumptions.rolling_basis: Existing APA rolling-shear reference times permanent-load factor0.90.
assumptions.creep_basis: Deliberately reduced effective interface stiffness:10% retained. Engineering allowance/sensitivity, not a published T88 creep factor or a life prediction. Strength references are assumed to remain applicable in the stated service envelope.
assumptions.service: Dry indoor service, panel moisture below16%, approximately room temperature, working range10–30C; sound veneers and a continuous properly cured bond.
assumptions.interaction: Project linear envelope: (abs(tau_xy)+abs(tau_xz))/Fs + max(sigma_xx/Ft,-sigma_xx/Fc) <=1; no compression-induced shear-strength benefit credited. Not an APA-prescribed multiaxial law.
